notes.engine_chassis: Primitive engine-rendered backing is a permanent layer and fallback. It is distinct from, and remains underneath, terminal_chassis.png.
notes.screen_can_be_replaced: Render Raid UI into the screen polygon or use it as an alpha/UV mask; do not move the player to simulate a camera feed.
notes.controls: Darken individual key rectangles at runtime within the controls layer; all decorative layers share the identical 975x1024 canvas and destination rectangle.
notes.asset_distribution: Approved terminal PNG bytes are local runtime/test assets and are not required to be published in the public source repository. Runtime source must use the exact documented paths and hashes.
